newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares ignore uncertain foreign tone.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares ignore uncertain foreign tone.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Shares ignored the uncertain international tone to close firmer. Volumes were swollen by end-month activity by banks and insurers. The market could gain further on Friday, particularly if New York stages a recovery, traders said.
*In recent months, the first day of trading has seen heavy volume of business, they noted.
*Traders said that the first half results of Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor and Mundial Confianca were in line with expectations. But Banco Totta was below the more optimistic predictions.
*Banco Sotto boosted profit by 194 percent while Totta's firmst half performance fell 12.5 percent.
*Nevertheless, there could be some profit-taking on Banco Sotto and Mundial Confianca on Friday because both stocks have seen sharp rises in recent sessions, traders said.

*EDP closed down, against the trend. The consortium in which the group was involved did not win the bidding for Brazil's Coelba at its privatisation and the stock has been under pressure for several sessions.
*Retailer Jeronimo Martins rose 1.33 percent to 11,501 escudos in unusually heavy trade of 166,000 shares after Credit Suisse First Boston issued a buy recommendation.
*PSI-20 .PSI20 closed 0.81 percent higher at 8,035.47 but the August futures only rose 19 points to 8,010.
